test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are indicated by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99d70360f86bac6a5582069743c4fcddece31da64b4ff1905cd31e97ad9a198e.png]
solution:
From the dices,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dc0149d90d834824a4c2d4fe21057227e93899891d73864bf49f0d7c28515a3.png] 

1, 4,and 3 cannot be opposite 6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99ed11f6c21af8cc3af97b8d58070e693765a7fbdc01194c2e79c2c4a0280946.png] 

3 and 4 cannot be opposite of 5 and 6.

Therefore, 5 will be at the opposite of the face showing 6.

Hence, the correct answer is **"6".**
